$comment: Contract: CONTRACT-004 | Status: PROPOSED (post-ADR-0005; awaiting sign-off) | Version: 0.2.0 | Author: Role C (@rohan) | Consumed: Role B (assert_state lives on the MCP server), Role D (harness parses traces). Two schemas: (1) delegate_task input, (2) the subagent result envelope that is the ONLY thing injected into the main context after a subagent's context is dropped. Normative source of truth for the expect match-language and layer1_query (ADR-0005); CONTRACT-003 assert_state references these $defs via x-source-of-truth so there is ONE definition, each file staying self-contained for tools/list.

layer1_query.description: A Layer 1 (query) tool call. The `query` half of assert_state / success_criteria.

tool.description: Name of a Layer 1 query tool (e.g. list_windows, get_window_contents, list_widgets, get_element_tree). MUST be a tool the caller is authorized to invoke.

expect.description: Closed match-language over a Layer 1 query's output (ADR-0005). Pure function of (query_output, expect); no code execution; no regex. All present keys must hold (logical AND); `where` is applied first.

where.description: Filter query output to rows whose value at each JSON Pointer deep-equals the given value, BEFORE the other keys are evaluated. Keys are JSON Pointers (RFC 6901) relative to the output (e.g. '/windows/0'). Optional.

exists.description: true  => the query produced a non-empty result (a non-empty list, or a present node). false => the query produced an empty/absent result.

count.description: Assert the length of the (post-`where`) list output. Either an exact integer or an inclusive range.

field_eq.description: Each JSON Pointer key MUST resolve, and its value deep-equals the given value (deep-equal for object/array, scalar-equal otherwise). Keys are JSON Pointers (RFC 6901) relative to the (post-`where`) output.

text_contains.description: Substring(s) that MUST all be present in the query output rendered to text (the `markdown`/`detail` field, or the JSON serialized for tools without a text field). AND over array elements; case-sensitive.

expect.$comment: At least one of {exists, count, field_eq, text_contains} MUST be present (enforced via minProperties below where this is referenced as the success_criteria.expect). `where` alone does not assert anything.

element_id.description: An element-id per CONTRACT-001 v0.2.0. We validate the STRUCTURE (a known <type>, then ': ', then a non-empty path) but NOT the inner path characters: CONTRACT-001 rule 2/4 + its Type-table examples nest element-ids inside paths (el:win:42/menubar/file, act:wgt:desktop/clock/rotate), which the formal <segment>=[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+ grammar cannot express. See ADR-0005 §Open issue for D. The path must not be empty and must not contain whitespace.

success_criteria.description: The verify contract. The subagent runs `query`, then assert_state matches the output against `expect`. status=success REQUIRES assert pass (ADR-0005 status mapping). MUST be DE-observable, never subjective.

allOf.description: A criteria MUST actually assert something: at least one of the four assert keys is required. `where` alone filters but asserts nothing (ADR-0005).

delegate_task_input.description: Tool call the main agent makes to spawn an ephemeral, scoped subagent. The subagent MUST call assert_state with success_criteria before emitting status=success.

goal.description: Operational, DE-verifiable objective. NEVER subjective ('looks good'); phrased so success_criteria can prove it.

tools.description: Whitelist of MCP tool names the subagent MAY call (least privilege). MUST include the success_criteria.query.tool, or the subagent cannot self-verify.

model_hint.description: Routing hint. small=qwen2.5:3b triage; large=the 8B (per C-002).

subagent_result_envelope.description: Schema-validated result the subagent emits. Its context is then DROPPED; ONLY this object enters the main context. status↔assert mapping is pinned by ADR-0005.

status.description: success => assert_state pass=true. failed => assert ran and returned pass=false, OR a tool/verify error. blocked => turn/token cap (max_turns) hit, OR a required capability/tool was absent.

summary.description: 1-3 lines. What was achieved (or why not). The ONLY free-text that enters the main context.

reason.description: REQUIRED when status ∈ {failed, blocked}. Machine-categorizable short cause (e.g. 'assert_failed', 'tool_error', 'turn_cap', 'capability_absent').

changes.description: DE-observable before/after per affected element. Empty for read-only subagents.

evidence.description: Reference to the assert_state run that backs this result. Logged in JSONL (CONTRACT-005); NOT injected into the main context by default. Field set mirrors assert_state output (CONTRACT-003).

pass.description: assert_state pass flag (field name mirrors CONTRACT-003 assert_state.output). MUST equal (status == 'success').

snapshot_ref.description: assert_state snapshot_ref; correlates this run to a JSONL record / HITL viewer frame.

diff.description: assert_state diff (human-readable expectation gap) when pass=false; null/absent on success.

tokens_used.description: Total tokens consumed by the subagent's dropped context. Budget signal.

allOf.$comment: A failed/blocked result MUST carry a reason.

then.$comment: A success result MUST carry evidence.pass == true (ADR-0005).

rules: assert pass                                  => subagent MAY emit status=success (evidence.pass == true)
assert ran, pass=false  OR  tool/verify error => status=failed  (reason REQUIRED)
max_turns hit  OR  required capability absent => status=blocked (reason REQUIRED)
